visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A stylish young man with dark, swept-back hair stands in a restaurant foyer. He wears a light blue and white vertical striped button-down shirt over a white t-shirt. He speaks animatedly to the camera, gesturing with his hands which are folded or pointing. The background shows wooden walls and a large bull logo. (2) The scene shifts to the interior dining room. The man is shown at a table with a friend wearing a yellow baseball cap. On the table is a plate of thin-sliced wagyu beef being seared with a kitchen torch, turning the meat from red to brown. The lighting is warm and bright. (3) In a POV-style shot, a large, marbled piece of raw pink beef is held up with metal tongs, dangling in front of the camera. The background shows the restaurant's salad bar and buffet area with various vegetables and signage. The man appears in a small circular inset, reacting. (4) Detailed close-ups of the dual-compartment hotpot on a portable stove. One side contains a clear, bubbling broth. A hand uses a small glass cup to pour a citrus-colored liquid into the soup. Various fresh vegetables and mushrooms are visible in the surrounding bowls. (5) The man is shown eating a bite-sized piece of meat with a side of dipping sauce. He then holds up a black bowl containing a clear yellow jelly with bits of citrus peel. In the next shot, he takes a large bite out of a fish-shaped taiyaki waffle filled with white ice cream. (6) The man stands near a restaurant staff member who is wearing a pink mask and a blue uniform. They hold a fan-like array of yellow cards. The man picks one, revealing a card for shrimp. Confetti-like graphics appear on screen as they celebrate. (7) A final shot features the man and two friends sitting at the table, surrounded by empty plates and food. They all look at the camera and wave or point, with the restaurant's "Yuzu Season" promotional poster held up in the center.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic pop music with a steady 128 BPM beat starts immediately. A male voice delivers a rapid-fire, enthusiastic intro with clear Chinese articulation. The pitch is moderate but varies frequently for emphasis. A faint indoor restaurant hum is barely audible beneath the mix. (2) A sharp "whoosh" transition sound effect occurs, followed by the distinct hissing sound of a butane torch. The BGM remains constant. The narrator's tone rises in excitement as he describes the wagyu sushi. A "ding" bell sound effect marks a key textual highlight on screen. (3) The sound of liquid pouring into a pot—a rhythmic "glug-glug" splash—is clearly heard over the music. The narrator continues with high-density speech, describing the price point of 29 dollars. The acoustic dynamism increases as more percussive sound effects are layered in. (4) Incidental sounds of metal chopsticks clinking against ceramic bowls and the subtle rustle of clothing are audible. The narrator’s voice maintains a high arousal level and positive valence. A "pop" bubble sound effect accompanies the visual transition to dessert. (5) A short burst of canned applause and a higher-pitched female voice are heard during the card-game segment. The female voice exclaims "Congratulations!" in Chinese. The BGM swells slightly in volume during this celebratory moment, adding to the energetic atmosphere. (6) The music enters a concluding phrase with a final melodic stinger. The main male narrator gives a final call to action with a slightly lower, more authoritative but still friendly tone. All background chatter and ambient noise are cut off sharply at the very end.
